text: The authors define Degeneration-of-Thought as the situation where, once an LLM-based agent has established confidence in its answers, it cannot generate novel thoughts through self-reflection even if its initial stance is incorrect. They state this problem is proposed and defined by them for the first time.
title: Degeneration-of-Thought (DoT): self-reflection cannot escape a confident wrong stance
